_comment: Description transcribed from the in-game Custom Search screen, captured 2026-08-05 (Steam capture 20260805170513), which had Breakthrough selected and so showed its full text. The other five live modes are named on the same screen but not described.
name: Breakthrough

description.text: Fight on one side of a frontline battle for territory. As attackers, capture objectives to take enemy sectors. As defenders, hold your positions and stop the enemy advance.

_art_note: Art is the little badge the game prints beside GAME MODE on the Custom Search screen, not a scene, so it renders at icon size rather than filling the art column. Cut from the same capture as the description.
